recognize_zh: 左圖巴氏染色（Pap）抹片中可見散在的大型多形性細胞，核大、不規則或腎形、核仁明顯，細胞質豐富；右上低倍 H&E 為大片纖維素性（fibrinous）物質，右下高倍可見其中散布的大型異型細胞；植入物周圍積液中出現這類大型異型細胞是乳房植入物相關 ALCL 的典型線索。
features: Left (Papanicolaou smear): large discohesive cells with abundant cytoplasm and large irregular, reniform or lobulated nuclei
Prominent nucleoli and coarse chromatin in large cells; multinucleated/bizarre forms present
Background small lymphocytes, neutrophils and histiocytes, some with engulfed debris
Right upper (H&E, low power): abundant eosinophilic fibrinous material with scattered cellularity
Right lower (H&E, high power): large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei and nucleoli embedded in fibrin
No cohesive epithelial clusters or glandular structures
describe_en: Composite of a Papanicolaou-stained effusion smear and H&E sections of fibrinous material. The smear shows discohesive large pleomorphic cells with abundant cytoplasm, irregular to reniform or lobulated nuclei, coarse chromatin and prominent nucleoli, admixed with small lymphocytes, neutrophils and histiocytes. The H&E sections show abundant fibrinous exudate containing scattered large atypical cells with vesicular nuclei. No cohesive epithelial groups are identified. Findings are consistent with involvement of the periprosthetic effusion by breast implant-associated anaplastic large cell lymphoma, to be confirmed by uniform CD30 positivity and ALK negativity.

ddx.vs: Reactive seromas contain histiocytes and a mixed lymphoid population without monomorphic large cells showing uniform strong CD30 and loss of T-cell antigens.
Carcinoma forms cohesive clusters with cytokeratin and GATA3 positivity and lacks CD30/CD4 expression.

ddx.dx: Breast implant-associated large B-cell lymphoma / DLBCL
ddx.vs: Large B-cell lymphoma shows CD20+/PAX5+ cells, often EBV-positive in fibrin-associated types, rather than CD30+ ALK-negative T cells.
